overview.title: Draft steps end at a checked publication boundary
overview.explanation: Flow arrows describe construction steps, not class inheritance. Rejected steps throw and leave the normal path. The final Plan is a separate value, not the same draft renamed. The builder can keep drafting after publishing a snapshot. The comments are teaching annotations; they do not add state transitions to the implementation.

focus.what: This operation decides whether draft choices form a usable plan.
focus.where: The PlanBuilder boundary between setup and execution.
focus.why: Rules involving the entire object cannot be checked by one duration setter.
focus.invariant: Only complete drafts with total at most 90 become Plan values.
focus.risk: Checking each add alone would allow an invalid 120-minute total.

focus.title: Use a named recipe when the sequence repeats
focus.what: This function records the standard introduction plan recipe.
focus.why: Repeated construction choices should have one named home.
focus.invariant: The same builder validation applies to recipe-built products.
focus.risk: A recipe must not bypass build or expose the unfinished builder as a Plan.
